name: SaaS Access LAB
description: API collection for SaaS Access LAB: the zero-standing-access story across SaaS platforms (GitHub, GitLab, Salesforce, Snowflake, Databricks, Google Workspace). Preview a time-boxed access request against the approval routing (mock mode), and read the story catalog with its platforms, roles and honest field sources. The gateway check needs live mode (real_not_available in mock — the negative case).

folders.name: Sanity (mock, labelled)
folders.description: Health, mode info and the story catalog: platforms with their resources and levels, the approval roles, and the honest limits.

folders.name: Preview an access request (mock)
folders.description: e.preview(body.request) with {mode:'mock', request:{...}}. requestedBy must be the subject or the subject's manager (an agent's custodian); resource must be one of the platform's resource ids from /api/story.

requests.name: Preview a valid request (manager requests for engineer)

folders.name: Gateway check (live only)
folders.description: The gateway-check endpoint needs live mode with SAL_GW_URL/SAL_GW_APPS/SAL_GW_KEY_* configured; in mock it answers 409 real_not_available — the negative case here.
